messages:
sara: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — consolidating DR action items and owners. I sketched a short plan, assigning tentative owners and ETA. Can owners confirm or update?
jonathan: ack. share the list please.
sara: paste below (short):
- multi-region routing: investigate route-priority leak during peak failover -> owner: jonathan -> ETA: 2w
- backup validation automation: flaky snapshot verification in us-west -> owner: lee -> ETA: 1w
- restore runbook gaps: missing db restore steps for partial-region restores -> owner: maria -> ETA: 3w
- game-day checklist: rehearsals need explicit rollback step + pager matrix -> owner: ops (ryan) -> ETA: next game day (2026-05-14)
- recurring incident pattern doc: aggregate 3 month incidents for RCA -> owner: sara -> ETA: 4w
lee: I can take backup validation. quick Q: do we want synthetic restores daily or weekly? I recommend daily smoke restore for critical buckets.
maria: for restore runbook I'll add the partial-region DB play and a step to rehydrate caches. also will add exact commands and timelines.
ryan: ops (ryan) here — I can own the game-day checklist. can we lock the rehearsal date to 2026-05-14 as sara suggested? that works for infra oncall.
jonathan: router issue — I'll dig into router logs and route-priority updates. suspect a race between the control-plane promotion and BGP announce script. will instrument and add metrics.
incident-bot: Note: postmortem ticket PM-824 created and linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-824 :page_with_curl:
sara: please add the ticket numbers on each action item and update owners in the tracker doc: https://docs.redwood.com/ops/dr-action-tracker (edit privileges: eng,ops)
lee: adding test plan to the tracker now. snippet of smoke restore sequence I'm proposing:
```
# smoke restore
aws s3 cp s3://customer-backups/latest ./tmp && ./restore --schema-only --limit=100
curl -f http://healthcheck.internal/restore-smoke
```
maria: tagged the runbook PR and linked to ticket PM-825. PR: https://git.redwood.com/runbooks/merge_requests/432
jonathan: putting a small instrumentation patch into canary for router controller, will notify once available. ETA 3 days.
sara: owners — please add expected rollout windows and fallback plans into the tracker. also note any cross-team dependencies (eg network team approval for BGP changes). we'll sync Wed 09:30 for a 20m check-in.
ryan: noted. I'll schedule rehearsal invites and include the required guardrails. also will prep rollback templates and pager matrix.
jonathan: re: recurring incidents doc — do we want to include cost/latency impact metrics? that helps prioritize.
sara: yes — include cost/latency + freq. I'll prepare a template and drop it in the tracker.
lee: ETA updates: backup validation smoke -> in progress, will be done by 2361199999 (1 week). leaving a short checklist under the ticket.
maria: runbook draft ready for review by 2361350000 (3 weeks). ping me on review channel.
sara: thanks all. final ask: once you update tickets, react :white_check_mark: in this thread so I can close the postmortem follow-up loop. we'll track owners in the tracker and follow up during Wed sync. :eyes:
